To give power, strength, or vigour to (oneself or someone, or to something); to strengthen.

examples.text: If he made transcendental distinctions, he fortified himself by drawing all his illustrations from sources disdained by orators and polite conversers; from mares and puppies; from pitchers and soup-ladles; from cooks and criers; the shops of potters, horse-doctors, butchers, and fishmongers.

glosses: To increase the nutritional value of (food) by adding ingredients, especially minerals or vitamins.

examples.text: Soy milk is often fortified with calcium.
